description: Test suite for media utility functions and media stream info classes in the starboard media namespace, using Google Test framework.

classes.name: AudioStreamInfo
classes.description: Represents audio stream information, with conversions to and from platform-specific structures.

classes.name: VideoStreamInfo
classes.description: Represents video stream information, with conversions to and from platform-specific structures.

classes.name: AudioSampleInfo
classes.description: Contains audio sample information, including stream info and key frame status.
